text.en:
The composition of the Board of Trustees of the Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage System
(MWSS) is hereby amended as follows;
The Minister of Public Works and Highways
The General Manager of the MWSS
Vice-Chairman
One (1) representative of the Labor Union representing majority of the rank and file of the employees of the
Four (4) others appointed by the President of the Philippines
Section 4 of republic Act No. 6234 is hereby modified accordingly.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 6th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-two.
